notes.title: DreamCell:Lost in Nightmares v.1.01
notes.notes:
Version 1.01:
-fixes a bug where the player could not pick up the weapon.
-new sound effects
-new bullet types for some weapons
-new effects for charging weapons
-changed stun lock from 1 second to 0.25
-weapon switch is faster ( it does not apply while a weapon is being used )
